<tool_call>
<function=generate_alternative_ending>
<parameter=original_story>
Margo, the savvy detective, has been on the tail of the elusive art thief known as 'The Phantom' for years. In the original story, Margo finally catches The Phantom in a climactic encounter at the Louvre, revealing him to be her long-lost brother.
</parameter>
<parameter=established_elements>
["Margo is a savvy detective", "The Phantom is an elusive art thief", "Climactic encounter at the Louvre", "The Phantom is Margo's long-lost brother"]
</parameter>
<parameter=alternative_ending>
Instead of arresting him, Margo realizes that The Phantom has been stealing the artworks not for profit, but to expose a corrupt collector who had stolen them from her family years ago. She decides to help him return the pieces to their rightful owners, effectively becoming partners in justice rather than enemies.
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
